Replace: Replace original after verification — no backup
BackupHint: Replacement deletes the original after a smaller output passes full verification. Keeps the base name; videos become MP4 and images WebP. Existing sibling files are never overwritten.
DestinationHint: Leer: neben der Quelle. Kopien behalten Unterordner bei. Ersetzen nutzt den Quellordner.
ImageHint: JPEG / PNG / WebP zu WebP bei gleichen Abmessungen. Kein RAW und keine animierten Bilder.
HighBitHint: Nur H.265: SDR mit mindestens 10 Bit zu 10 Bit 4:2:0. HDR wird übersprungen. Kameraoriginale behalten.
QueueHint: Ordner wählen und Suchen und komprimieren. Keine manuelle Auswahl nötig.
ProfilesHint: Eigene Einstellungen je Auflösung für Hoch- und Querformat. Abmessungen und Bildzeitpunkte bleiben erhalten.
QualityGuide: 16–20: usually high quality. 21–23: balanced. 24–30: smaller files with more visible detail loss. These are guidelines, not loss percentages. Faster presets may produce larger files at the same quality setting. Compare a sample first.
GuideText:
1. Choose a folder and resolution settings.
2. Choose copies or replacement.
3. Click Search and compress.

Test speed, time and quality lets you choose one video directly, without scanning a folder. The temporary sample is deleted after measurement.

Scan files only is optional for manually choosing files. Replacement deletes originals after full verification. Larger outputs are discarded. Video becomes MP4 and images become WebP with the same base name. Existing sibling files are never overwritten.
Limits: Keine Pause/Fortsetzung. HDR übersprungen, AAC-Audio und möglicher Metadatenverlust. GPU-Geschwindigkeit hängt von Hardware und Treiber ab.
ReplaceWarning: The original will be permanently deleted only after a smaller output passes full verification. No backup remains. Keeps the base name; extension may change to MP4/WebP. Compression can lose detail. Continue?

Based on up to 20 seconds; excludes encoder selection and quality measurement. Replacement adds full verification time.
RecoveryFound: Wiederherstellungstransaktion gefunden. .framepress-transaction-*.json prüfen und Sicherung vor erneutem Versuch wiederherstellen.
AccelerationHint: Auto benchmarks available encoders briefly and chooses the fastest measured. Select NVIDIA, Intel or AMD to try that backend; CPU is the fallback. The actual encoder appears above. This benchmark measures speed, not quality.
VerificationHint: Copies use basic checks by default. Replacement always performs full decoding before deleting the original; this adds time.
CrfHelp: CPU CRF controls quality: lower usually means higher quality and larger files. CRF 20 does not mean 20% loss. GPU CQ/QP values are not equivalent across encoders.
QualityMeasured: Sample SSIM similarity: {0}/100. Index difference: {1} points out of 100. This is not a percentage of perceived quality lost or a guarantee for the whole video.
QualityUnavailable: Sample similarity measurement unavailable. The quality setting cannot be converted into a reliable loss percentage.
SampleLarger: Warning: the sample predicts a larger output. Full compression will keep the original if no space is saved. Try a slightly higher quality-number or H.265, then sample again.
